governmentSchemes.name: Free Legal Services (NALSA)
governmentSchemes.description: Provides free legal aid, advice, and representation in courts for eligible marginalized sections of society.
governmentSchemes.applicationProcess: Apply online at nalsa.gov.in or visit the nearest DLSA/SLSA office

governmentSchemes.name: Nyaya Bandhu (Pro Bono Legal Services)
governmentSchemes.description: Connects marginalized individuals seeking legal help with Pro Bono Advocates volunteering their time.
eligibility: Members of Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes
governmentSchemes.applicationProcess: Install the Nyaya Bandhu mobile application and register as an applicant

governmentSchemes.name: Tele-Law Service
governmentSchemes.description: Facilitates delivery of legal advice through an expert panel of lawyers via video conferencing and telephone.
eligibility: All Citizens (Free for marginalized, nominal fee for others)
governmentSchemes.applicationProcess: Visit nearest Common Service Centre (CSC) or use the Tele-Law Citizen Mobile App

governmentSchemes.name: PM Matru Vandana Scheme
governmentSchemes.description: Maternity Benefit Scheme providing direct cash benefits to pregnant women and lactating mothers.
eligibility: Lactating mothers for first living child
benefits: Cash incentive of ₹5000 in three installments
governmentSchemes.applicationProcess: Register at nearby Anganwadi Centre (AWC) or approved health facility

legalAidOrganizations.name: National Legal Services Authority (NALSA)
legalAidOrganizations.description: Apex body constituted under Legal Services Authorities Act to provide free legal services to the weaker sections.

legalAidOrganizations.name: Human Rights Law Network
legalAidOrganizations.description: Collective of lawyers and social activists providing legal support to marginalized and oppressed people.

legalAidOrganizations.name: People's Union for Civil Liberties (PUCL)
legalAidOrganizations.description: Largest human rights organization in India fighting for civil liberties and democratic rights.

legalAidOrganizations.name: Maharashtra State Legal Services Authority
legalAidOrganizations.description: State authority extending NALSA's free legal aid scheme across Maharashtra.

legalAidOrganizations.name: Majlis Legal Centre
legalAidOrganizations.description: Legal center providing rights-based interventions for women in distress, focusing on domestic violence and sexual abuse.

steps: Speak to SHO or on-duty officer

Get a copy of the FIR

steps: Obtain marriage certificate form from Sub-Registrar office
Fill the form with both parties' details
Submit documents - date of birth proof, address proof
